answer: The plume escrow is released only against a spiral receipt, and the reef audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 57 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 115 aliases means carrying 26 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 14 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
